name: CRA + Nginx (dev)
postStartCommand: if [ -d /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/host ] && [ "$(ls -A /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/host 2>/dev/null)" ]; then cp -f /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/host/* /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ 2>/dev/null || true; update-ca-certificates 2>/dev/null || true; fi
